name: Apify
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: cloud platform for building and running web-scraping/automation Actors, with full REST API over actors, runs, datasets, storages and schedules.
access_notes: Free plan includes monthly platform usage credits with no credit card; API token available immediately from Console > Settings > API & Integrations and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' (or token query param, discouraged). OAuth browser flow is offered for connecting the hosted MCP server.
mcp_notes: Official hosted vendor MCP at https://mcp.apify.com (OAuth or Bearer token; open-source @apify/actors-mcp-server for stdio). Composio toolkit exists at composio.dev/toolkits/apify with 112 tools.
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks=true based on Apify's documented platform webhooks for Actor run events (docs.apify.com/platform/integrations/webhooks); that specific page was not fetched this pass.

evidence.note: REST API v2 at api.apify.com/v2; API token from Console Integrations page sent as Bearer header (recommended) or token query param
'Free plan includes monthly platform usage credits with no credit card required'; API, MCP, CLI and client-library access all via API token
Official Apify MCP server at mcp.apify.com with OAuth flow or Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
Composio Apify toolkit page listing 112 tools (actors, builds, runs, datasets, etc.)
